guard: a family follower's stored copies (#5404): fan-out routes the family rows above a channel, the reader accepts a copy that any covering row holds, two covering rows store one copy because the dedupe id is per message and lifecycle, each channel's own delivery class decides, and the reader still re-checks the read ACL per concrete channel
why: The suite imports CotalEndpoint from ../src/index.js, but @cotal-ai/smoke-kit resolves @cotal-ai/core through dist/, so the command builds core first and afterRestore rebuilds it, leaving no dist/ compiled from a mutant.
Every 'stores nothing' cell is closed by a later post on a channel that does store, so a mutation that stops delivery entirely reddens the marker half rather than passing the negative half.
